leaderboard.rules: Team awards compare trained models only. Supplied Sophon stays visible as a frozen reference. Efficiency requires AUC within 0.02 of the best trained final result; lower normalized time wins.
leaderboard.timing_caveat: Self-reported. The fixed CPU reference is only an approximate hardware adjustment, not a certified cross-device benchmark.

score_semantics: Model scores are not calibrated collider probabilities. Labels are simulated truth, kept separate from predictions.
threshold_policy: Compute threshold curves from complete prediction/population rows, never the 200 display jets.
